svg.title: Cardiac electromechanics as a recursive operator split
svg.desc: Cardiac electromechanics splits into electrophysiology and mechanics, and each of those splits again: electrophysiology into diffusion along the axial resistors and the node-local cell model at the ion channel boxes, mechanics into the contracting chambers with their sarcomere model and the 0D circulation loop. The same split, one level deeper.
svg.text: one split into two operators — and each of those splits again
